title: The meeting after the meeting
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: State the meeting purpose — Separate exploration, advice, and approval.; Invite relevant concerns — Make space for dependencies and uncertainty.; Record the decision — Name owner, conditions, and next actions.; Return new evidence — Update the shared record when consequences change..
